frame.note: The region reported, not a located site.

attribution.name: NASA Worldview Snapshots
attribution.note: Public domain, courtesy of NASA EOSDIS GIBS.

before.shows: What the eye would see from orbit. Cloud is white, forest dark green, silt-laden floodwater pale brown.

after.shows: A water map, not a photograph. Radar passes through cloud, so this is available on days no optical sensor can see the ground. Coloured area is standing water at the time of the pass.
after.overpass: satellite pass, either ascending or descending

comparable_note: The two frames come from different instruments — true colour before, surface water, from radar after — because nothing else could see the ground on both dates. They are shown side by side rather than as a slider: sliding between two instruments shows the instrument changing.
